# API reference generated by MrDocs (https://mrdocs.com) from the /// comments
# of include/neko and main/samples. MrDocs reads the compilation database, so
# the samples are only documented when they are built (USE_SAMPLES or
# USE_TESTING).
find_program(MRDOCS_EXECUTABLE mrdocs
    HINTS "$ENV{MRDOCS_ROOT}/bin" "${MRDOCS_ROOT}/bin"
    DOC "MrDocs executable")
if(NOT MRDOCS_EXECUTABLE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NEKO_BUILD_DOCS is ON but mrdocs was not found: put it "
        "on PATH or set MRDOCS_ROOT (https://github.com/cppalliance/mrdocs/releases)")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "NEKO_BUILD_DOCS needs CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON")
endif()
if(NOT (USE_SAMPLES OR USE_TESTING))
    message(WARNING "NEKO_BUILD_DOCS: the samples are not built, so they are "
        "missing from the documentation")
endif()

set(NEKO_DOCS_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/docs")
add_custom_target(docs
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E rm -rf "${NEKO_DOCS_DIR}"
    COMMAND "${MRDOCS_EXECUTABLE}"
        "--config=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mrdocs.yml"
        "--compilation-database=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json"
        "--output=${NEKO_DOCS_DIR}"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    COMMENT "Generating the API reference in ${NEKO_DOCS_DIR}/index.html"
    VERBATIM)
message(STATUS "NekoPhysics: `cmake --build` the docs target to generate ${NEKO_DOCS_DIR}/index.html")
